record.original_question: Consider the treeSSYTof shifted standard Young tableaux, with the tree structure generated by containment. Computation suggests that the only automorphism ofSSYT(as an unlabeled tree) is the identity. Computation further suggests that each node ofSSYTis uniquely determined by the census (cardinalities) of the ranks of the subtree rooted at the node.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A shifted standard Young tableau of size n is a filling of the shifted Young diagram of a strict partition λ = (λ₁ > λ₂ > ⋯ > λₖ > 0) with λ₁ + ⋯ + λₖ = n (the diagram has row i indented i−1 places to the right and contains λᵢ boxes) by the integers 1, 2, …, n, each used exactly once, such that entries strictly increase along every row and every column.

Build a rooted tree T whose vertices are all shifted standard Young tableaux of all sizes n ≥ 0, where the root is the unique empty tableau (n = 0), and the parent of a shifted standard Young tableau S of size n ≥ 1 is the shifted standard Young tableau of size n−1 obtained by deleting the box containing the entry n from S. (Equivalently, vertices are ordered by containment of the underlying labeled fillings, and the tree structure is generated by this containment.) The rank of a vertex is its size n; for a vertex v, let cₖ(v) denote the number of descendants of v at rank rank(v) + k for each k ≥ 0, and call the sequence (cₖ(v))_{k≥0} the census of the subtree rooted at v.

Resolve the following two assertions:

(a) The only automorphism of T, viewed as an unlabeled rooted tree, is the identity.

(b) Every vertex v of T is uniquely determined among all vertices of T by the census (cₖ(v))_{k≥0} of the subtree rooted at v.
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface any paper resolving these conjectures attributed to Dale R. Worley about the rigidity of the tree of shifted standard Young tableaux under containment. The conjectures appear in a recent compilation of open problems on tableau combinatorics and no resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: A theory of shifted Young tableaux
status_evidence.snippet: Worley's foundational thesis on shifted Young tableaux, the context in which shifted SYT are introduced.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the framework of shifted standard Young tableaux used in the problem; no resolution of the automorphism/census conjectures is given.

status_evidence.title: Enumeration of Standard Young Tableaux (survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on enumeration of standard and shifted standard Young tableaux.
status_evidence.claim: Does not address automorphisms of the containment tree of shifted SYT.
